to stick or attach something onto a flat and vertical surface (such as flatbread dough onto the inner walls of a tandoor)

o.text: Borrowed from Classical Persian فیروزهای (fīrūza'ī). By surface analysis, firuzə (“turquoise”) + -i.

From Old Anatolian Turkish [Term?], from Middle Mongol ᠵᠠᠮ (ǰam), whence also Mongolian зам (zam). Ultimately from Middle Chinese 站 (treamᴴ).
By surface analysis, yam + -çı.
